source: Rule-of-thumb bands for what a month away costs ON TOP of the fixed costs that continue at home — slow travel abroad in low-cost regions around $800–1,200 a month, domestic travel around $1,500, a high-cost country around $2,500.
confidenceNote: Bands, not prices. A person who sublets their home or ends a lease will see a very different number; the template shows the band it used and the answer can be changed.
note: Extra monthly cents over the baseline month; 'home' adds nothing. Keyed by the sabbatical template's `where` answer. D-086.
